scientific_limitations_and_integrity.computational_checks: A finite checker tests identities and sample trends; no infinite theorem follows from the finite tests.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.exact_scope: Fixed -1<alpha<0 and beta_N=alpha+2+lambda/log N, square two-sided polynomial truncation; uniformly bounded real lambda; entrywise squared Hilbert-Schmidt energy.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.priority_limits: The gamma/Hilbert matrix formula is attributed to Li and Zhou, and possible implicit older homogeneous-kernel analogues remain a priority risk.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.proof_boundary: Analytical joint weak limit and O(1)-accurate Hilbert-Schmidt squared-norm crossover; separate supercritical 1/epsilon asymptotic; no spectral eigenvalue distribution is asserted.
